verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
God will make a way
When there seems to be no way

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
He works in ways, we cannot see
He will make a way for me

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
He will be my guide
Hold me closely to His side

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
With love amd strength
For each new day

verse.name: c1e
verse.lines:
He will make a way
He will make a way

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
By the roadway in the wilderness
He'll lead me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Rivers in the desert will I see
Heaven and earth will fade

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
But His love will still remain
He will do something new today
